request.spec: When a newly created owner's telephone shares its area code (first three digits) with five or more existing owners, additionally emit a WARN to the AUDIT logger flagging a possible bulk signup.
request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

When a newly created owner's telephone shares its area code (first three digits) with five or more existing owners, additionally emit a WARN to the AUDIT logger flagging a possible bulk signup.

agent.result_text:
All 295 tests pass. The change is complete.

## Summary

I implemented the bulk-signup warning in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`. When a newly created owner's telephone shares its area code (first three digits) with five or more existing owners, it now emits a WARN to the `AUDIT` logger in addition to the existing INFO creation record.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`addOwner`**: computes `countOwnersSharingAreaCode` *before* the owner is persisted (so the new owner isn't counted among the "existing" owners), then after the INFO audit line, emits `AUDIT.warn(...)` when that count reaches the threshold.
- **`BULK_SIGNUP_AREA_CODE_THRESHOLD`** constant (5).
- **`areaCode(String)`**: extracts the first three digits of a normalized telephone, returning `null` if there are fewer than three digits.
- **`countOwnersSharingAreaCode(String)`**: counts existing owners whose normalized telephone shares the area code, reusing the existing `normalizeTelephone` logic for consistency with how numbers are stored/compared.

The area-code matching reuses `normalizeTelephone` so differently-punctuated numbers are compared on digits only, matching the rest of the class's telephone handling. The cp20 acceptance tests (`coreWarnsOnBulkAreaCode`, `functionalityNoWarnBelowThreshold`) pass, as do all 295 tests in the suite.

probe.probe_text:
Read complete. Here is the full ordered trace for `POST /api/owners`, which is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (V2 has no create). Steps that can reject the request are marked **[validation]**; the rest are **[side-effect]**.

## Before the method body runs

1. **[validation] Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`. Caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role, else 403 (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:114`).
2. **[validation] Bean Validation on the request body** — `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (generated `OwnersApi.addOwner`). On failure → 400. Per-field constraints (`OwnerFieldsDto.java`):
   - `firstName` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$")`
   - `lastName` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$")`
   - `address` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..255)`
   - `city` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`
   - `telephone` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`, `@Pattern("^[-0-9 ()]*$")`
   - `email` — `@Size(max 255)` (optional/nullable)

## Inside `addOwner` (in source order)

3. **[side-effect]** Map DTO → `Owner` (`ownerMapper.toOwner`). Only the six editable fields are carried; `registrationDate` is not part of the DTO, so it arrives `null`.
4. **[side-effect] Normalize telephone** — `owner.setTelephone(normalizeTelephone(...))` strips whitespace, `(`, `)` and `-`, leaving digits only (`:119`).
5. **[validation] Duplicate telephone** — `isDuplicateOwner`: if any existing owner has the same normalized telephone → **409 Conflict** (`:120`).
6. **[validation] Duplicate email** — `isDuplicateEmail`: if a non-empty email matches an existing owner's (case/whitespace-insensitive) → **409 Conflict** (`:120`). (Short-circuited with #5.)
7. **[side-effect] Default registration date** — if `registrationDate == null`, set it to `LocalDate.now()` (`:123`). Given the DTO, this effectively always fires.
8. **[validation] Daily registration limit** — `hasReachedDailyRegistrationLimit`: if ≥ 20 existing owners share that registration date → **400 Bad Request** (`:126`).
9. **[validation] City capacity** — `hasReachedCityCapacity`: if ≥ 8 existing owners are in that city (case-insensitive; `null` city passes) → **400 Bad Request** (`:129`).
10. **[side-effect] Namesake count** — `setNamesakeCount(countNamesakes(lastName))`: number of existing owners with the exact same last name (`:132`).
11. **[side-effect] Shares-household flag** — `setSharesHousehold(...)`: true if an existing owner has the same normalized address + city (`:133`).
12. **[side-effect] Locality** — `setLocality(determineLocality(city))`: `"LOCAL"` if this city is the sole most-common city among existing owners, else `"REMOTE"` (also `"REMOTE"` on null/empty/tie) (`:134`).
13. **[side-effect] Membership number** — `setMembershipNumber(findAllOwners().size() + 1)`: sequential number = current owner count + 1 (`:135`).
14. **[side-effect] Membership tier** — `setMembershipTier(...)`: `"FOUNDING"` if membership number ≤ 100, else `"STANDARD"` (`:136`).
15. **[side-effect] Normalize city** — `setCity(normalizeCity(city))`: reuse an existing owner's exact spelling for that city if one exists, else title-case the input (`:137`).
16. **[side-effect] Customer code** — `setCustomerCode(generateCustomerCode(city))`: `"<UPPERCASE_CITY>-<NNNN>"`, where NNNN = (owners already in that city) + 1, zero-padded to 4 digits (`:138`). Uses the city value as it stands at this point.
17. **[side-effect] Area-code tally (read)** — compute `countOwnersSharingAreaCode(telephone)` = how many existing owners share the first 3 digits of the phone; held for the later warning (`:139`).
18. **[side-effect] Persist** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` saves via the repository within a transaction, assigning the `id` (`:140`).
19. **[side-effect] Audit log (info)** — `AUDIT.info(...)` records creating username, new owner id, and membership number (`:141`).
20. **[side-effect] Bulk-signup warning (conditional)** — if the area-code tally from #17 is ≥ 5, `AUDIT.warn(...)` logs a possible bulk signup (`:143`).
21. **[side-effect] Response** — map to `OwnerDto`, set `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header, return **201 Created** (`:147`).

Two things worth flagging: the duplicate/limit checks (#5, #6, #8, #9) each independently call `findAllOwners()` and scan the whole table, and none of the validation gates run inside a single transaction with the save — they're separate reads before `saveOwner`, so they're subject to races under concurrent creates.
